data.name: htmlContentEn.Value
data.value:
="TO Whom It May Concern

" + "" + Fields.EmployeeTitleEnglish + " " + Fields.FullNameEnglish + " requested us an experience letter of " + Fields.PronounPossessive + " service rendered during " + Fields.PronounPossessive + " stay in our company.

" + "Therefore, we would like to certify that " + Fields.EmployeeTitleEnglish + " " + Fields.FullNameEnglish + " had been worked under our company at " + Fields.DepartmentEnglish + " from " + Fields.StartDateGregorian + " to " + Fields.EndDateGregorian + " on the position of " + Fields.JobTitleEnglish + ".
and " + Fields.PronounSubject + " was earning:

" + "
" + "✓ Monthly Gross Salary         : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.MonthlyGrossSalary) + (Fields.ResponsibilityAllowance > 0 ? "
✓ Responsibility Allowance   : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.ResponsibilityAllowance) : "") + (Fields.ProfessionalAllowance > 0 ? "
✓ Professional Allowance     : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.ProfessionalAllowance) : "") + (Fields.HouseAllowance > 0 ? "
✓ House Allowance            : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.HouseAllowance) : "") + (Fields.TransportAllowance > 0 ? "
✓ Transport Allowance        : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.TransportAllowance) : "") + "

" + (Fields.IsCurrentEmployee = False ? (Fields.PronounSubject + " resigned up on " + Fields.PronounPossessive + " own will on " + Fields.ResignationDateGregorian + " finally we would like to further notify that all the necessary due taxes and pension contribution had been deducted from " + Fields.PronounPossessive + " salary and paid to the concerned Inland Revenue Authority.") : "Finally, we would like to further notify that all the necessary due taxes and pension contribution had been deducted from " + Fields.PronounPossessive + " salary and paid to the concerned Inland Revenue Authority.")

data.name: htmlContentAm.Value
data.value:
="ለሚመለከተው ሁሉ

" + "የድርጅታችን የሥራ ባልደረባ የነበሩት " + Fields.EmployeeTitleAmharic + " " + Fields.FullNameAmharic + " በድርጅቱ ውስጥ የሰሩበት ጊዜ ተጠቅሶ የስራ ልምድ እንዲሰጣቸው ጠይቀዋል::

" + "በዚህ መሰረት " + Fields.EmployeeTitleAmharic + " " + Fields.FullNameAmharic + " በድርጅታችን እንደ በሆነው " + Fields.DepartmentAmharic + " ላይ ከ " + Fields.StartDateAmharic + " ዓ.ም እስከ " + Fields.EndDateAmharic + " ዓ.ም ድረስ በ "" + Fields.JobTitleAmharic + "" የስራ መደብ፤

" + "
" + "✓ የወር ደመወዝ ብር         : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.MonthlyGrossSalary) + (Fields.ResponsibilityAllowance > 0 ? "
✓ የኃላፊነት አበል ብር         : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.ResponsibilityAllowance) : "") + (Fields.ProfessionalAllowance > 0 ? "
✓ የሙያ አበል ብር              : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.ProfessionalAllowance) : "") + (Fields.HouseAllowance > 0 ? "
✓ የቤት አበል ብር              : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.HouseAllowance) : "") + (Fields.TransportAllowance > 0 ? "
✓ የትራንስፖርት አበል ብር  : " + Format("{0:N2}", Fields.TransportAllowance) : "") + "

" + "እየተከፈላቸው ሲሰሩ ቆይተው " + (Fields.IsCurrentEmployee = False ? "በራሳቸው ፍላጎት ከ " + Fields.ResignationDateAmharic + " ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ከድርጅታችን ጋር የነበራቸው የሥራ ውል የተቋረጠ ሲሆን፤ " : "") + "ከሠራተኛው የሚጠበቀውን የመንግስት የሥራ ግብር እና የጡረታ መዋጮ ከደመወዛቸው እየተቆረጠ ለሚመለከተው አካል ገቢ እየተደረገ መቆየቱን እንገልፃለን::"
